# Feature request

## Problem

What user problem should this solve?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest useful version of the feature.

## Privacy and consent

Does this require new stored data, notifications, trusted contacts, health data, outbound messages, or a backend service?

## Alternatives

Can this be solved with PWA behavior, local storage, iOS Shortcuts, Android widgets, or documentation first?

## Notes

Avoid features that create hidden tracking, silent outbound messages, unclear consent, or unnecessary health-data collection.
